passage: Through the open door I saw Sachin, five, knock over his glass of milk at breakfast. He went very still, hands at his sides, and his eyes filled. He began to back away towards the corner. His grandfather Irfan said, "Oops, milk everywhere," and fetched a cloth. "Come, you take that side." Sachin sniffled, then wiped alongside him, his small hand pushing the cloth. When the table was dry Irfan said, "All clean." Sachin's shoulders came down, and he asked for more milk and held the glass with both hands.

qa.q: What was Sachin feeling when he went still and began to back away?
qa.a: Scared, afraid of being told off.

qa.q: What did Irfan do that helped?
qa.a: Irfan stayed calm, fetched a cloth and invited Sachin to wipe up together.

qa.q: What did Irfan's calm reaction show about how Irfan saw the spill?
qa.a: Irfan saw it as a small, fixable accident and nothing to be angry about.

grounding: Shows a young child freezing and crying after a spill, and calm cleaning up together showing that mistakes are fixable.

passage:
Monday. Arnab dropped his toy truck, and a wheel snapped off. He hid under the bed with the wheel in his fist.

Tuesday. Neelam sat on the floor beside the bed. "Did the wheel come off? That happens with toys." She held out her hand. Arnab came out, and together they fixed the truck with a dab of glue, Arnab holding the wheel in place while it set.

Friday. Arnab spilled his water at dinner. He looked up, then said, "Mama, I spilled. Can I get the cloth?" and fetched it himself.

qa.q: What happened to the toy truck on Monday?
qa.a: A wheel snapped off when Arnab dropped it.

qa.q: What was Arnab feeling when he hid under the bed?
What did Neelam do that helped Arnab?
qa.a: Neelam sat on the floor calmly, said it happens with toys, and fixed the truck together with Arnab.

qa.q: How might Neelam have felt when Arnab said "Mama, I spilled"?
qa.a: Proud and relieved to see Arnab feel safe enough to tell her and fix it himself.

grounding: Shows a young child hiding after breaking a toy, then learning through calm repair that mistakes can be fixed.
